api_key.description:
Straiker Defend API key.
This field is [referenceable](/gateway/entities/vault/#how-do-i-reference-secrets-stored-in-a-vault).
This field is [encrypted](/gateway/keyring/).

timeout_ms.description: Timeout for a synchronous scoring call, in milliseconds.

fail_open.description: If Straiker Defend is unreachable or errors, allow traffic when true, or reject with a 503 when false. Applies to the request and the response phase.

max_response_bytes.description: Skip response scoring above this size, in bytes.

relay_response.description: Relay the model's streamed response to Straiker Defend after it has shipped.

relay_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for the asynchronous response relay, in milliseconds.

consumer.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer has been authenticated.

consumer_group.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer group has been authenticated.

route.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via the specified route.

service.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via one of the routes belonging to the specified Service.

protocols.description: A list of the request protocols that will trigger this plugin.
